title: Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level or Equivalent Recruitment Examination for Specialist Posts/ Services 2026
summary: The Odisha Staff Selection Commission (OSSC) has released a detailed advertisement for the Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level or Equivalent Recruitment Examination for Specialist Posts and Services 2026, offering 132 vacancies. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official OSSC portal.
eligibility_bullets: Must meet the minimum qualification level of 10+2 or equivalent as specified in the detailed advertisement.

vacancy_breakdown.category: Technical Assistant, Weaving Supervisor and More
vacancy_breakdown.notes: Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Specialist Posts

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official OSSC website at https://www.ossc.gov.in
Navigate to the Apply Online section for the relevant advertisement
Complete the registration and fill out the online application form
Submit the application before the final deadline
